sentences.en: In 2010, the Obama administration effectively declared the group defeated.
sentences.zh: 2010年，奥巴马政府实际上宣布该组织已被击败。

sentences.en: The Americans who have served in Iraq completed every mission they were given.
sentences.zh: 在伊拉克服役的美国人完成了他们被赋予的每一项使命。

sentences.en: They defeated a regime that had terrorized its people.
sentences.zh: 他们击败了一个曾经对其人民实施恐怖统治的政权。

sentences.en: And began the accelerated pullout of American troops from Iraq.
sentences.zh: 并开始加速从伊拉克撤军。

sentences.en: So tonight, I am announcing that the American combat mission in Iraq has ended.
sentences.zh: 因此今晚我宣布，美国在伊拉克的作战任务已经结束。

sentences.en: Operation Iraqi Freedom is over.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克自由行动已经结束。

sentences.en: And at that point in time, the estimates that we had were that the group was down to its last 700 fighters.
sentences.zh: 而在那个时候，我们当时的估计是，该组织只剩下最后700名武装分子。

sentences.en: That U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美军

sentences.en: forces managed to pick off and either arrest or kill three quarters of the group's top leaders.
sentences.zh: 成功消灭、逮捕或击毙了该组织四分之三的高层领导人。

sentences.en: And in a history of that period of time that ISIS itself put out, they described how the emir of the group had lamented to his fighters that they were so exhausted, so weak,
sentences.zh: 在 ISIS 自己发布的那段历史中，他们描述了该组织的埃米尔如何向战士们诉苦，称他们是如此疲惫、软弱

sentences.en: and so depleted that the Islamic State could only hold ground for 15 minutes at a time.
sentences.zh: 且兵力耗尽，以至于伊斯兰国每次只能坚守阵地15分钟。

sentences.en: Anything longer than a quarter of an hour, and they would be overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 只要超过一刻钟，他们就会被压垮。

sentences.en: So it really did look like this group was on its last legs.
sentences.zh: 所以当时看起来这个组织确实是强弩之末了。

sentences.en: But in fact, what we saw is that every year since then, 2011, 2012, 2013, the number of attacks that this group was doing per month started to spike.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，我们看到的是，自那以后每一年——2011年、2012年、2013年，该组织每月的袭击次数开始飙升。

sentences.en: So in 2011, according to a database that is maintained by researcher Michael Knights, they were doing 358 attacks per month just in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据研究员迈克尔·奈茨维护的数据库，仅在伊拉克，2011年他们每月发动358次袭击。

sentences.en: By 2012, it was 539 per month.
sentences.zh: 到2012年，这一数字是每月539次。

sentences.en: By 2013, it was 804 per month.
sentences.zh: 到2013年，则是每月804次。

sentences.en: So in a very short period of time, a group that I think legitimately looked like it was defeated,
sentences.zh: 所以在很短的时间内，这样一个看起来名正言顺被击败的组织，

sentences.en: I agree with the assessment of the Obama administration that the group appeared to be on its way out.
sentences.zh: 我同意奥巴马政府的评估，即该组织当时确实走到了末路。

sentences.en: It was very quickly able to regenerate itself and become a deadly force in the absence of American pressure.
sentences.zh: 在失去美军压力的情势下，它非常迅速地完成了自我繁衍，重新成为一股致命的力量。

sentences.en: So what was happening that allowed that to occur?
sentences.zh: 那么，究竟发生了什么才导致了这种局面的出现？

sentences.en: Well, for one, American forces pulled out.
sentences.zh: 首先，美军撤出了。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, our partners in the region, they weren't able to keep fighting this group at the same intensity that had happened under a coalition effort.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们在该地区的盟友无法继续以联军努力时期那种相同的强度来打击这个组织。

sentences.en: And so they went from this ragtag insurgency of just 700 militants to carrying out insurgent tactics all over Iraq.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们从最初仅有700名武装分子的乌合之众，变成了在整个伊拉克实施叛乱战术的武装。

sentences.en: They began doing targeted assassinations where they were assassinating village elders in small localities and small villages.
sentences.zh: 他们开始进行有针对性的暗杀，在小地方和小村庄里谋杀村长。

sentences.en: You would think that that would not be a tactic that would help them.
sentences.zh: 你可能会认为这种战术对他们没有什么帮助。

sentences.en: But in fact, what it was doing is in that village where that village elder was killed, immediately people understood that the most important game in town was ISIS,
sentences.zh: 但事实上，这样做产生的结果是，在那个村长被杀的村子里，人们立刻明白现在当地最说了算的是 ISIS，

sentences.en: not the Iraqi security forces who had failed to protect that village leader.
sentences.zh: 而不是未能保护村领导的伊拉克安全部队。

sentences.en: So they carried out these targeted assassinations.
sentences.zh: 所以他们实施了这些定向暗杀。

sentences.en: And in so doing, they began to have more recruits.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他们开始招募到更多的成员。

sentences.en: And in really three, four short years, they were so strong that in 2014,
sentences.zh: 在短短三四年里，他们变得如此强大，以至于在2014年

sentences.en: they were able to blitz across Iraq and Syria and take a territory that was literally the size of Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 他们能够横扫伊拉克和叙利亚，占领了一片面积堪称英国大小的领土。

sentences.en: That was, of course, the declaration of their caliphate.
sentences.zh: 这当然就是他们宣布建立哈里发国的时候。

sentences.en: So this idea that ISIS was defeated and that it was time to pull out, which was the calculation of the Obama administration, this was a complete miscalculation.
sentences.zh: 因此，认为 ISIS 已经被击败、是时候撤军的这种想法——也就是奥巴马政府的算盘——完全是一个误判。

sentences.en: It was clearly premature.
sentences.zh: 这显然为时过早。

sentences.en: But to be fair to them, the metrics look good when they made the decision.
sentences.zh: 但公平地说，他们在做出决定时，各项指标看起来确实很不错。

sentences.en: On paper, it looked like the group was really on its way out.
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，这个组织似乎真的在走向消亡。

sentences.en: And that's where the declarations that the White House has been making now are so puzzling.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，白宫现在发表的这些声明才显得如此令人困惑。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because if you just compare the history of then to now, the numbers now are so much more worrying.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你把当时的历程与现在做个对比，如今的数据要担忧得多。

sentences.en: So according to three different studies that have just been done, including by the Pentagon Inspector General, by the United Nations, by CSIS,
sentences.zh: 根据刚刚完成的三项不同研究，其中包括五角大楼监察长、联合国以及战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）的报告，

sentences.en: ISIS is now estimated to have between 20,000 and 30,000 fighters just in Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 据估计，目前仅在伊拉克和叙利亚境内，ISIS 就拥有2万至3万名武装分子。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's more than 20 to 30 times what they had in 2010.
sentences.zh: 这比2010年时的数字多出了20到30倍。

sentences.en: More than 20 to 30 times.
sentences.zh: 多出了20到30倍之多。

sentences.en: So obviously, if it was not actually defeated in 2010,
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，如果当年2010年并没有真正被击败的话，

sentences.en: why in the world would we be saying that it's defeated now when it has many magnitudes more fighters than they had previously?
sentences.zh: 为什么在现在的武装分子数量比过去多出好几个数量级的时候，我们反倒会说它已经被击败了呢？

sentences.en: I just want to be clear about those numbers.
sentences.zh: 我只是想把这些数字搞清楚。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There are 20 to 30,000 ISIS fighters in Iraq and Syria.
sentences.zh: 在伊拉克和叙利亚有2万到3万名 ISIS 武装分子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Compared to 700 in 2010.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，2010年只有700人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, the caveat to that is these are, of course, estimations.
sentences.zh: 当然，这里需要说明的是，这些自然都只是估计数字。

sentences.en: There's no national registry of ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 并没有一个 ISIS 武装分子的国家登记册。

sentences.en: There's no census of ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 也没有 ISIS 武装分子的全国人口普查。

sentences.en: And there are people that have criticized the 20,000 to 30,000 numbers saying, wait, this is way too large.
sentences.zh: 有些人曾对2万至3万这个数字提出批评，认为“等等，这实在太夸张了”。

sentences.en: But what I find significant is that three different groups, independent of each other, the United Nations, the Pentagon Inspector General, and CSIS,
sentences.zh: 但我认为意义重大的是，三个彼此独立的群体——联合国、五角大楼监察长以及 CSIS

sentences.en: the Center for Strategic and International Studies, they have all come independently to the same conclusion.
sentences.zh: （战略与国际研究中心），他们各自独立得出了相同的结论。

sentences.en: All three of them are saying that the group is now between 20,000 and 30,000 fighters in reports that they published late last year.
sentences.zh: 他们在去年年底发布的报告中都指出，该组织的武装分子目前在2万到3万之间。

sentences.en: So, Rukmini, if there are that many more ISIS fighters now than there were in 2010,
sentences.zh: 那么，鲁克米尼，如果现在 ISIS 武装分子的数量比2010年多了这么多，

sentences.en: what would lead the United States and all of these leaders in the Trump administration to make this declaration that ISIS is defeated?
sentences.zh: 又是什么促使美国以及特朗普政府的这些领导人做出 ISIS 已经被击败的声明呢？

sentences.en: So, Michael, let me give you the most innocent explanation for that.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，那我给你一个最单纯的解释吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Most people became aware of ISIS when ISIS declared its caliphate, its so-called state, and blitzed across this region and took this enormous territory.
sentences.zh: 大多数人注意到 ISIS 是在 ISIS 宣布建立哈里发国、即所谓的国家，并横扫该地区、占领这片庞大领土的时候。

sentences.en: So, for as long as people in the general population have known ISIS, it's been associated with holding territory.
sentences.zh: 因此，只要普通民众知道 ISIS 的存在，它就一直与占据领土联系在一起。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it is true that the territory that it had in Iraq and Syria is almost all gone.
sentences.zh: 而且事实确实如此，它在伊拉克和叙利亚拥有的领土几乎已经全部丧失。

sentences.en: It has less than 1% of the territory it once held.
sentences.zh: 它所控制的领土已经不到其曾经拥有领土的1%。

sentences.en: I've just been checking in with sources on the ground.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚向实地的消息人士进行了核实。

sentences.en: The group is now down to three villages just in Syria.
sentences.zh: 目前该组织在叙利亚境内只剩下三个村庄了。

sentences.en: And I believe that one of those three is about to fall.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信这三个村庄中的其中一个也快要失守了。

sentences.en: So, really, it's down to two.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，只剩下两个了。

sentences.en: So, what people have done is they have mistaken the territory-holding group with the group itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们所做的事情，是把占据领土的这个集团同该组织本身混为一谈了。

sentences.en: What they're forgetting is that ISIS is just another name of a group that has been in Iraq since 2002, 2003.
sentences.zh: 他们忘记了，ISIS 不过是一个自2002、2003年以来就一直存在于伊拉克的组织的新名字。

sentences.en: And only since 2014 and really till around 2017 did the group really hold a lot of land.
sentences.zh: 而且直到2014年、甚至差不多到2017年左右，该组织才真正占领了大量的土地。

sentences.en: And at that point in time, they were imposing taxes on people, they were issuing birth certificates, they were fixing potholes and fixing the electricity grid.
sentences.zh: 在那个时期，他们向人们征收税款，他们发放出生证明，他们修补路坑和电网。

sentences.en: You suddenly saw a terrorist group that, for all of our attempts to downplay them and to call them a so-called state, really were acting like a proto-state.
sentences.zh: 你突然看到一个恐怖组织，尽管我们竭力贬低他们、称其为所谓的国家，但他们的确在像一个准国家那样行事。

sentences.en: And that was a frightening prospect.
sentences.zh: 那是一个令人恐惧的前景。

sentences.en: And for a couple of years, it just seemed like there was no way to dislodge them.
sentences.zh: 在好几年的时间里，似乎根本没有办法将他们驱逐。

sentences.en: So, I think that there is a reason why people are equating these two things.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，人们将这两者画上等号是有原因的。

sentences.en: But what they're missing is the history of this group.
sentences.zh: 但他们忽视的是这个组织的历史。

sentences.en: This is a terrorist group that only held land for the last couple of years of its more than 15-year history.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在其长达15年以上的历史中，只有最后几年才占据土地的恐怖组织。

sentences.en: And for all of those 15 years, the group has been incredibly deadly and incredibly destructive most of those years without holding any territory at all.
sentences.zh: 而在那所有的15年里，在绝大部分时间里，即便完全不占领任何领土，该组织也一直极其致命、极具破坏力。

sentences.en: So, what you're saying is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，美国

sentences.en: justifiably started to think of ISIS as a territory, as you said, a proto-state.
sentences.zh: 理所当然地开始将 ISIS 视为一块领土，正如你所说，一个准国家。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But now that that territory has shrunken, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在这片领土已经萎缩，美国

sentences.en: hasn't quite adjusted to that reality in thinking about the group's overall strength and danger.
sentences.zh: 在思考该组织的整体实力和危险性时，还没有完全适应这一现实。

sentences.en: Certainly, that is what is being reflected in the decision to pull out of Syria.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，从叙利亚撤军的决定就反映了这一点。

sentences.en: I'll tell you, I'm in Iraq right now.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，我现在就在伊拉克。

sentences.en: And this is a country that I've been to many times covering the effort against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我为了报道打击 ISIS 的行动而已去过很多次的国家。

sentences.en: When I was coming here in 2016, in 2017, even in parts of 2018, we knew exactly where the front line against ISIS was.
sentences.zh: 当我在2016年、2017年、甚至2018年的部分时间里来到这里时，我们确切地知道对抗 ISIS 的前线在哪里。

sentences.en: First, it was in this city, then it was in that city, then in this town, then in that village.
sentences.zh: 首先是在这座城市，然后在那座城市，接着在这个小镇，然后那个村庄。

sentences.en: And I knew that I had a reasonable expectation that if I was on the coalition side of that front line, that I was protected, right?
sentences.zh: 我知道我有合理的预期，如果我处于前线联军的那一边，我是受到保护的，对吧？

sentences.en: Now, ISIS is technically gone as a territorial entity from Iraq.
sentences.zh: 现在，作为领土实体的 ISIS 从技术上讲已经从伊拉克消失了。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you, recently I went to the birthplace of Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, the leader of the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 但我必须告诉你，我最近去了伊斯兰国头目阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪的出生地。

sentences.en: This is a place that was liberated many months ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几个月前就被解放的地方。

sentences.en: And the security forces who took me there stopped our convoy three different times on the way to this little village.
sentences.zh: 带我去的安全部队在前往这个小村庄的路上，设卡拦下了我们的车队整整三次。

sentences.en: And we had to have lengthy negotiations with them about whether we should continue because they were too scared to advance.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不与他们进行长时间的谈判，讨论是否应该继续前进，因为他们太害怕而不敢继续深入了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because they themselves know that ISIS is there.
sentences.zh: 因为他们自己心里清楚，ISIS 就在那里。

sentences.en: But it's like you've kicked the hornet's mast, right?
sentences.zh: 但这就像是你捅了马蜂窝一样，对吧？

sentences.en: They're no longer in one specific place.
sentences.zh: 他们不再待在某个特定的地方。

sentences.en: They've basically bled into the population.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上已经融入到了民众当中。

sentences.en: They're hiding among civilians.
sentences.zh: 他们藏在平民中间。

sentences.en: They're now everywhere and anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们现在无处不在，随时可能出现。

sentences.en: And so they could strike at any time.
sentences.zh: 因此他们随时可能发动袭击。

sentences.en: So as you've explained, there are significant numbers of ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 正如你所解释的，ISIS 仍有大量的武装分子。

sentences.en: And they're hiding in the general population of Iraq and Syria, basically blending in now that the territory has been shrunken.
sentences.zh: 而且随着领土的萎缩，他们现在正藏匿在伊拉克和叙利亚的普通民众中，基本上与平民混为一体。

sentences.en: So what are we seeing from them that signals how strong ISIS really is there?
sentences.zh: 那么我们从他们身上看到了什么信号，能说明 ISIS 在那里究竟有多强大？

sentences.en: So what we've seen is in areas that were declared liberated by the coalition and which look stable, we're seeing ISIS do counterattacks and push back into those areas.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的是，在那些被联军宣布解放且看起来很稳定的地区，ISIS 正在发动反击并重新渗入这些地区。

sentences.en: And in some instances, they've been able to retake areas that had just been declared liberated.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们甚至能够重新夺回刚刚被宣布解放的地区。

sentences.en: And we've seen that both in Iraq and in Syria.
sentences.zh: 我们在伊拉克和叙利亚都看到了这一点。

sentences.en: More worrying than that is the attack that happened last week in the Syrian town of Manbij.
sentences.zh: 比这更令人担忧的是上周在叙利亚曼比季镇发生的袭击事件。

sentences.en: News out of Syria were following reports of a car bombing in Syria that has killed U.S.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚传出消息，我们正在关注叙利亚发生的一起汽车炸弹袭击事件的报道，该事件已造成美国

sentences.en: troops.
sentences.zh: 军人死亡。

sentences.en: Two soldiers, one civilian and one contractor, were killed.
sentences.zh: 两名士兵、一名平民和一名承包商遇难。

sentences.en: And three more servicemen wounded.
sentences.zh: 另有三名军人受伤。

sentences.en: The bomb went off near a restaurant where a delegation of American and European visitors was having lunch.
sentences.zh: 炸弹在一个餐馆附近爆炸，当时一个由美国和欧洲访客组成的代表团正在那里吃午饭。

sentences.en: The patrol was likely in that area providing security for the...
sentences.zh: 这支巡逻队当时很可能在该地区为……提供安全保障

sentences.en: This was a place that was considered so safe that American forces were openly walking around this market and going to a popular lunch spot to have their daily meal.
sentences.zh: 这个地方过去被认为非常安全，以至于美军可以公开在这个市场上走动，并去一个受欢迎的午餐地点吃日常工作餐。

sentences.en: Just as a data point, in the four years that American troops have been in Syria, before this incident, only two other Americans had died in combat.
sentences.zh: 作为一个数据参考，在美军进驻叙利亚的四年里，在此次事件发生之前，仅有另外两名美国人在战斗中丧生。

sentences.en: So in a matter of moments, that one incident more than doubled the American death toll for this operation in Syria.
sentences.zh: 因此，在短短片刻之间，这起事件就使美军在叙利亚这次行动中的死亡人数翻了一番还多。

sentences.en: I wonder if in some ways what happened in Syria inside this restaurant feels like kind of a metaphor for this larger issue you're describing,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在某种程度上，叙利亚这家餐厅内发生的事情，是否感觉像是你所描述的那个更大问题的一种隐喻，

sentences.en: which is that it appeared the area was safe and yet ISIS was still able to carry out an attack, which feels a bit like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那就是，这个地区表面上看起来是安全的，然而ISIS仍然能够发动袭击，这感觉有点像美国的

sentences.en: overall assessment, which is it feels like ISIS's land is gone, so ISIS is not that big a threat.
sentences.zh: 整体评估，即感觉ISIS的地盘已经没了，所以ISIS不再是个多大的威胁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think you're spot on, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我觉得你一针见血。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that what we're seeing is a White House that thinks that because the territory has now been removed, that the group is no longer a threat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们看到的是，白宫认为既然领土现在已经被清除了，这个组织就不再是威胁了。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, four Americans came back in body bags last week.
sentences.zh: 而不幸的是，上周有四名美国人是用裹尸袋运回来的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In part because of this incident assumption.
sentences.zh: 部分原因正是因为这种先入为主的假设。

sentences.en: Rukmini, given what you explained about 2010 and the Obama administration assessment, which turned out to be a miscalculation,
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，鉴你所解释的关于2010年及奥巴马政府评估的情况，事实证明那是一个误判，

sentences.en: and knowing that the Trump administration and its military leaders must know that lesson as well as you do, why does it feel like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并且考虑到特朗普政府及其军方领导人肯定也和你们一样清楚这个教训，为什么感觉美国

sentences.en: isn't learning the lessons of that era when it comes to thinking about ISIS being on its last legs now?
sentences.zh: 在认为ISIS现在已经日薄西山时，却没有吸取那个时代的教训呢？

sentences.en: You know, Michael, I've been thinking about this a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，我一直在深刻思考这个问题。

sentences.en: And I think part of it is that really since 2014, we have been working in such a conscientious way to beat this group back from the cities that they held.
sentences.zh: 我想部分原因在于，实际上自2014年以来，我们一直以极其负责任的态度，努力将这个组织从他们占领的城市中赶出去。

sentences.en: What analysts have told me is that as monstrous as the caliphate seemed and as big as their territory was when that military operation began in 2014 and 2015,
sentences.zh: 分析人士告诉我，正如2014和2015年军事行动开始时哈里发国看起来多么庞大、其领土多么广阔，

sentences.en: in a way, that was the easy part.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，那反而是比较容易的部分。

sentences.en: That was the conventional war phase of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 那是这场冲突的常规战争阶段。

sentences.en: You had a front line and you had advancing troops and you were basically moving towards the incoming fire from ISIS.
sentences.zh: 当时有前线，有推进的军队，你们基本上是在朝着来自ISIS的火力迎头前进。

sentences.en: And they would identify that building, we're taking incoming fire from ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他们会锁定那栋建筑，我们正遭到来自ISIS的火力攻击。

sentences.en: Let's call it an airstrike.
sentences.zh: 呼叫一次空袭吧。

sentences.en: Okay, that building.
sentences.zh: 好的，就是那栋建筑。

sentences.en: Now that building.
sentences.zh: 现在是那一栋。

sentences.en: They were rolling in tanks into cities and fighting an army that was in some ways acting like a conventional army.
sentences.zh: 他们开着坦克冲进城市，与一支在某种程度上表现得像正规军的军队作战。

sentences.en: And they were firing rockets and artillery and going around in Humvees.
sentences.zh: 他们发射火箭弹和火炮，开着悍马到处跑。

sentences.en: Now the coalition and the coalition partners, the Kurds in Syria and the Iraqi security forces,
sentences.zh: 现在，联军和联军伙伴——叙利亚的库尔德人和伊拉克安全部队，

sentences.en: they have to do something that in a way is harder, which is they have to fight an insurgency, which is hiding among the population.
sentences.zh: 必须做一件在某种程度上更困难的事情，那就是他们必须打击隐藏在平民之中的叛乱分子。

sentences.en: And the only ethical way to do that is very carefully, because otherwise you're going to kill tons and tons of civilians.
sentences.zh: 而做到这一点的唯一道德方式就是非常小心，否则你会杀死成千上万的平民。

sentences.en: It's much harder to weed them out when they've cut off their beards, they're dressing like normal people,
sentences.zh: 当他们刮掉胡子、穿着像普通人一样，

sentences.en: and they're basically just hanging out in some farmhouse in the middle of some village.
sentences.zh: 而且基本上只是闲晃在某个村庄中间的农舍里时，要将他们甄别出来就难得多了。

sentences.en: Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch ally of President Trump, has been harshly critical of the president's strategy in Syria.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆是特朗普总统的坚定盟友，他一直严厉批评总统在叙利亚的战略。

sentences.en: President Trump's national security advisor, John Bolton, is now contradicting President Trump's comments about military action in Syria.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿现在正在反驳特朗普总统关于叙利亚军事行动的言论。

sentences.en: Bolton says United States troops will not leave the country until ISIS is destroyed and until our Kurdish allies have protection.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿表示，在消灭ISIS并且我们的库尔德盟友得到保护之前，美军不会离开该国。

sentences.en: I'm struck that over the past couple of weeks, the Trump administration, or at least certain members of it, seem to be having second thoughts about pulling out of Syria.
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊的是，在过去几周里，特朗普政府，或者至少是其中的某些成员，似乎对撤出叙利亚产生了犹豫。

sentences.en: John Bolton, for example, when in Israel, suggested that the pullout would be much, much slower.
sentences.zh: 例如，约翰·博尔顿在以色列时暗示，撤军过程将会慢得多、慢得多。

sentences.en: And it feels as if people are grappling with this question you are of maybe ISIS is stronger than we think, and we should slow this all down.
sentences.zh: 这让人觉得人们正在努力应对你所提出的这个问题：也许ISIS比我们想象的要强大，我们应该把这一切放慢脚步。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Well, I think from the reporting that The New York Times has done, what we know is that the people around Trump, his senior generals, his top advisors,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为根据《纽约时报》的报道，我们所了解的是，特朗普身边的人、他的高级将领、他的顶级顾问，

sentences.en: are all telling him that this is a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 都在告诉他这是一个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: In the several weeks that have passed since his announcement of the withdrawal in December of last year,
sentences.zh: 自从他去年12月宣布撤军以来已经过去了几个星期，

sentences.en: I've actually seen a change in Trump's language regarding this issue.
sentences.zh: 我实际上已经看到特朗普在这个问题上的措辞发生了变化。

sentences.en: The reason I'm here today is to personally thank you and every service member throughout this region
sentences.zh: 我今天来这里的目的，是向你以及整个地区的每一位军人表达个人感谢，

sentences.en: for the near elimination of the ISIS territorial caliphate in Iraq and in Syria.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们近乎彻底消灭了伊拉克和叙利亚境内的ISIS领土哈里发国。

sentences.en: He's no longer talking about the defeat of ISIS overall or even the defeat of ISIS in Syria.
sentences.zh: 他不再谈论全面击败ISIS，甚至不再谈论在叙利亚击败ISIS。

sentences.en: So it's as if he now understands that the territorial caliphate and defeating that is not the same thing as the overall defeat of the group.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比他现在明白了，领土哈里发国以及击败它，并不等于从总体上击败这个组织。

sentences.en: However, his overall stance remains the same.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的整体立场保持不变。

sentences.en: We're pulling our soldiers out and they will be pulled back in Syria and we're getting out of Syria.
sentences.zh: 我们要把士兵撤出来，他们将在叙利亚被撤回，我们要离开叙利亚。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: But we're getting out very powerfully.
sentences.zh: 但我们要以非常有力的方式撤出。

sentences.en: We don't know when, but they're going to pull out.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道什么时候，但他们会撤出的。

sentences.en: And what his own advisors are telling him is that there's no partner that they see that is reliable and that can step in on America's behalf to do this job.
sentences.zh: 而他自己的顾问告诉他的是，他们看不到任何可靠的、能够代表美国介入并完成这项工作的伙伴。

sentences.en: And so our pullout means that we're going to leave a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的撤军意味着我们将留下一个真空。

sentences.en: And we know that ISIS historically has done very well in vacuuMs.
sentences.zh: 我们知道ISIS在历史上在权力真空中一向表现得很好。

sentences.en: Rukmini, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程式时，在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程式，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, tens of thousands of Venezuelans took to the streets of the country's capital, Caracas, to call for the resignation of President Nicolas Maduro
sentences.zh: 周三，成千上万的委内瑞拉人走上该国首都加拉加斯的街头，呼吁尼古拉斯·马杜罗总统辞职，

sentences.en: and for the recognition of an opposition leader as his replacement.
sentences.zh: 并要求承认一名反对派领导人为他的继任者。

sentences.en: In a speech to the protesters, that opposition leader, Juan Guaido, the new head of the National Assembly, declared himself Venezuela's legitimate president.
sentences.zh: 在对抗议者的演讲中，身为国民议会新任领导人的反对派领导人胡安·瓜伊多宣布自己为委内瑞拉的合法总统。

sentences.en: Soon after, at least eight foreign countries, including Argentina, Chile, Colombia and the U.S., announced they would recognize Guaido as the country's leader, infuriating Maduro,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，包括阿根廷、智利、哥伦比亚和美国在内的至少八个外国政府宣布，他们将承认瓜伊多为该国领导人，这激怒了马杜罗，

sentences.en: who called it a U.S.-led conspiracy to topple him.
sentences.zh: 他称这是一场由美国主导的旨在推翻他的阴谋。

sentences.en: I've decided to break diplomatic relations and politics with the imperialist government of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我已决定与美国这个帝国主义政府断绝外交和政治关系。

sentences.en: By Wednesday afternoon, Maduro responded by cutting ties with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 到周三下午，马杜罗做出回应，切断了与美国的外交关系，并给予美国外交官72小时离开委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: and giving American diplomats 72 hours to leave Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 对马杜罗的抗议以及国际社会对瓜伊多的支持，反映出人们对马杜罗的日益愤怒，

sentences.en: The protests against Maduro and the international support for Guaido reflect growing anger over Maduro's
sentences.zh: 这些愤怒源于他压迫性的统治风格、可能存在欺诈的连任，以及在他领导下该国陷入贫困和恶性通货膨胀。

sentences.en: repressive style, his potentially fraudulent re-election, and the country's descent into poverty and hyperinflation under his leadership.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，南希·佩洛西刚刚做出了回应，她说她不会考虑一项两院联合决议，

sentences.en: Mr. President, Nancy Pelosi just responded and she said she will not consider a concurrent resolution
sentences.zh: 让你在1月29日来到众议院发表国情咨文。

sentences.en: to have you come to the House on January 29th to deliver you to the State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 你对众议院议长的回应是什么？

sentences.en: Your response to the House Speaker.
sentences.zh: 我并不感到意外。

sentences.en: I'm not surprised.
sentences.zh: 民主党人现在发生的事真是个耻辱。

sentences.en: It's really a shame what's happening with the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他们已经变得激进化了。

sentences.en: They've become radicalized.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统表示，他将为国情咨文演讲寻找替代场地，

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump said he would look for alternative venues for his State of the Union address
sentences.zh: 此前众议院议长南希·佩洛西再次告诉他，在政府重新开门之前，她不会邀请他在国会大厦的众议院议事厅发表该演讲。

sentences.en: after House Speaker Nancy Pelosi again told him she would not invite him to deliver it in the House chamber of the Capitol until the government reopens.
sentences.zh: 总统要在国会大厦发表国情咨文，需要获得众议院和参议院双方的同意。

sentences.en: The consent of both the House and Senate is required for the president to give the State of the Union in the Capitol building.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，总统向佩洛西妥协，称他将在政府关门结束后发表原定于1月29日进行的演讲。

sentences.en: A few hours later, the president capitulated to Pelosi, saying he would deliver the speech scheduled for January 29th after the shutdown is over.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在一条推文中写道，引述：

sentences.en: In a tweet, Trump wrote, quote,
sentences.zh: 没有任何场地能够与众议院议事厅的历史、传统和重要性相提并论。

sentences.en: There is no venue that can compete with the history, tradition, and importance of the House chamber.
sentences.zh: 我期待在不久的将来发表一场精彩的国情咨文演讲。

sentences.en: I look forward to giving a great State of the Union address in the near future.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
